[Previous context: The Program supports the
Government in (i) assessing the economic costs and benefits of a shift to greener growth, taking into account projected
climate change; and with this knowledge, (ii) prioritizing for implementation actions identified by the National Strategy for

Sustainable Development (NSSD) and supplemented by the Program's recommendations.] The Program is providing analytic work in five sectors (agriculture, water, transport, energy, and urban) and one cross-
cutting theme (social dimensions), along with overarching macroeconomic modeling that will integrate sectoral findings and
recommended actions and derive an optimal green growth policy package. After the conclusion of the analytic work, the
Program will shift towards technical assistance to support the Government in advancing its existing strategy for
sustainability towards implementation, by supplementing the assessments undertaken as part of the NSSD with the new
findings and recommendations under the Program. A more complete and updated strategy for green growth will result,

allowing development of an NSSD Action Plan.
